relationships.claim: The lung air-blood barrier establishes close contact between alveolar gas and pulmonary capillary blood, providing the structural interface across which respiratory-gas diffusion occurs.

Pulmonary gas exchange depends on ventilation bringing fresh gas to alveoli and perfusion bringing blood to alveolar capillaries; ventilation-perfusion mismatch can impair arterial oxygenation or carbon-dioxide elimination.
